title: Friends Who Sit Close By
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When Job was sad and feeling sick,
his friends came right away;
They did not try to fix a thing,
they simply came to stay.

[Chorus]
When someone's sad, you can be kind
by simply being near;
A hug, a hand, a quiet heart
says, "I love you, my dear."

[Verse 2]
At first they said no word at all,
they just sat on the ground;
A long, long time they stayed with Job,
and love was all around.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my little one,
I'm sitting here with you;
Heavenly Father's close by, too,
He'll stay the whole night through.

[Chorus]
mood: Hushed music. There is barely a pulse at all, only a slow, patient breathing under the voice, like friends who sit on the ground beside someone and say nothing. The first two verses stay hushed and near, the quiet doing the caring. By the last verse it settles lower and slower still, like a hand resting on a shoulder as sleep comes.
